summary: The test compiles and runs without Playwright API misuse. However, it lacks a valid selector for product cards and contains a placeholder comment, reducing coverage. The single locator assertion is minimal and does not verify navigation to product details or the presence of multiple product cards. The test title does not mention the testCaseId 'TC-001'. Selector quality and assertion strength are low due to incomplete selectors and weak validations.

issues.description: Comment indicates the product cards selector is missing or invalid, making the test incomplete.
issues.recommendation: Update the selector to a valid and specific data-test attribute or a reliable CSS selector to ensure product cards are effectively located.

issues.description: Test title does not include the testCaseId 'TC-001', which can hinder traceability.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title for easier mapping to requirements and test cases.

issues.description: Test only asserts visibility of the home navigator element and does not assert that product cards are displayed or validate navigation to product detail pages.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions to verify that product cards are visible and possibly clickable, and validate navigation to product details if intended.

recommendations: Implement and verify the product cards selector before automation.
Incorporate the testCaseId into the test name.
Enhance assertions to cover product cards presence and navigation behavior.
